name: ogservers-degoog-repo
description: OGServers extensions for Degoog — server monitoring and more.
author: OGServers

plugins.name: Server Uptime
plugins.description: Adds a Server Details button next to the settings icon showing uptime %, last downtime, outage history, and server info. Includes an optional sidebar card.

plugins.name: Users Online
plugins.description: Shows a live anonymous visitor count on the header button and optional sidebar card. Users can hide themselves from the count. Configurable inactivity timeout.
